backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing comment list management with CRUD operations, lock/unlock functionality, single/bulk comment generation with usage tracking, and role-based authorization for admin functions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that adds a 'locked' field (defaulting to false) to existing CommentList records when upgrading from old actor state to new actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: lock/unlock toggle, available vs. used comment tracking, refresh button, dynamic 'Add X Comments' button text, and individual comment display with badges.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration files for the comment generator application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including background, foreground, primary, secondary, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the React application titled 'APP REVIEW'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring React Query, theme provider, and TanStack Router with routes for customer view, upload, live list checker, and admin panel with token gate protection.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: Admin UI component for managing chat messages with input fields for sender and message, displaying message history, and handling message submission with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminComme: Admin UI component for managing comment lists with functionality to create lists, add comments (bulk or single), delete comments, toggle list locks, reset lists, and clear all lists.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminImage: Admin UI component for viewing and deleting uploaded rating images in a grid layout with image previews, uploader names, timestamps, and delete buttons.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLiveL: Admin UI component for managing live list apps and usernames with functionality to create apps, add usernames (bulk or comma-separated), delete apps, reset usernames, and reset all apps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Admin UI component for managing the bulk generator access key with functionality to view current key status (masked), set a new key, and reset the key with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/AdminTokenGate.t: Authorization guard component that checks admin token validity and displays access denied message or loading state before rendering protected admin content.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackdrop: Empty file placeholder for animated backdrop component.
Empty file placeholder for audio player card component.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Empty file placeholder for authentication gate component.
frontend/src/components/EffectBurst.tsx: Empty file placeholder for visual effects burst component.
frontend/src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx: Empty file placeholder for gallery grid component.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Empty file placeholder for login button component.
frontend/src/components/Rotating3DObject: Component rendering a 3D rotating cube with six colored faces using CSS transforms and animations.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Empty file placeholder for site footer component.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Root layout component with fixed background image, top segmented navigation, main content outlet, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution and UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/SiteNav.tsx: Empty file placeholder for site navigation component.
frontend/src/components/TeddyMascot.tsx: Empty file placeholder for teddy mascot component.
Sticky top navigation with segmented buttons for Customer View, Upload Section, Live List Checker, and conditionally-rendered Admin Panel based on admin token validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminComments.ts: React Query hooks for admin comment list management including fetching lists, creating lists, adding/bulk-adding comments, locking/unlocking lists, and deleting lists with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminToken.ts: Hook for managing admin authentication via a hardcoded token stored in sessionStorage, checking URL hash for token and providing admin access state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBulkGeneratorKey.t: React Query hooks for managing bulk generator API key status, setting new keys, and resetting keys with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all chat messages and adding new chat messages with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: React Query hooks for generating single and bulk comments from comment lists, checking bulk key status, and fetching list summaries with error handling for device limits and list availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient configuration with delegation identity handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListChecker.ts: React Query hooks for managing live list apps including checking usernames against lists, adding/deleting apps, managing usernames per app, and resetting functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useRatingImages.ts: React Query hooks for uploading, fetching, and deleting rating images with automatic query cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, pastel color schemes, utility classes for cards/buttons, and 3D rotating cube animations.
frontend/src/lib/deviceId.ts: Provides utilities for generating and storing a stable device identifier in localStorage, and tracking which comment lists have been used for single-generation on the current device.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabbed interface for managing comments, images, chat, live lists, and settings, using Shield icon branding.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerViewPage.tsx: Customer-facing page for generating single or bulk comments from selected lists, with device-based single-use restrictions and admin access code entry (7898).
frontend/src/pages/LiveListCheckerPage.t: Page for checking usernames against selected live list apps, with localStorage persistence for selections and results, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSectionPage.tsx: Page for uploading rating images with uploader name, featuring progress tracking and success feedback using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system, custom theme extensions, container settings, and plugins for animations and typography.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting an admin panel for comment list management with features including lock/unlock toggles, available vs used comment tracking, bulk upload, individual comment deletion, and a bulk totals dashboard. Architecture uses Motoko backend with React/TypeScript/Tailwind frontend, currently at version 3.
